en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers conducting field maneuvers in a forested landscape with sparse trees and underbrush. The soldiers wear light-colored tunics and caps, many kneeling with rifles, while officers stand or walk among them. The printed caption "Manöver." appears in red at the lower left, and "Manööveri." at the lower right. Along the left edge in red, a vertical imprint reads "G. Cederberg & Co., Wiborg, Wipuri." A small red number "6" appears at the bottom left corner.
